race.comment: SURROUND ME (8) was a touch plain last start at Northam when finishing fifth and 3 lengths off the winner. She may have needed all of her 3 runs this prep, and her best effort would make her the one to beat in this. Follow your money. CABLE ROCK (11) has turned his form around once he was back on good ground, following up a nose defeat here with an easy all-the-way win at Pinjarra nearly 3 weeks ago. Stick with him, despite the tough gate. RADIANT LIGHT (1) has also appreciated some firmer surfaces, and he was too slick at Pinjarra a week ago, when he went end-to-end to score by nearly a length. Each way claims again. CLEANEMUP (2) handy mare who finished sixth last start but was beaten only 2 lengths over 1200m at this track.
